visualCharacteristics.purpose: text and selling message beside a photo or video; the site's most common split layout

contentPattern.structure: one row: heading + text + optional list + CTA links | image or video link, in either order. An icon paragraph followed by copy in the text column becomes an icon callout. More rows stack more splits

reuseGuidance: Use for any text + media split. Pick Image Left to force the media first on desktop, Wide Image to widen it. For a wide intro beside a narrow benefits list use columns-benefits; for an article with a related-links rail use columns-sidebar.
